info.name: Asset Allocation API
info.description:
Walks the asset workflow: registering assets with unique tags and serials, search, assigning to one employee at a time, return requests, accepting returns into the available pool, assignment history, repair and retirement, the dashboard and security.
Start the backend first (http://localhost:8115). Repeatable: it registers a fresh employee and assets with a unique tag and serial each run.

exec: const day = (offset) => { const d = new Date(Date.now() + offset * 864e5); return d.getFullYear() + "-" + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0"); };

item.name: Register a fresh employee for this run

exec: pm.test("Format hints", () => { const e = pm.response.json().fieldErrors; pm.expect(e.assetTag).to.include("LT-1001"); pm.expect(e.serialNumber).to.include("4 to 30"); pm.expect(e.purchasePrice).to.include("negative"); });

item.name: A purchase date in the future is rejected

exec: pm.test("Available, tag and serial upper-case", () => { pm.expect(a.status).to.eql("AVAILABLE"); pm.expect(a.assetTag).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("tagA")); pm.expect(a.holderName).to.be.null; });

item.name: The tag cannot be reused in any case
The serial number cannot be reused in any case

exec: pm.test("Saved", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().name).to.eql("Postman Laptop Pro"); pm.expect(pm.response.json().notes).to.eql("Edited by the run"); });

item.name: Find by serial number, any case
Find by tag without the dash
A bad status filter is rejected
A due date today is rejected
Assign the laptop to the employee

exec: pm.test("Assigned, condition out recorded", () => { pm.expect(a.status).to.eql("ASSIGNED"); pm.expect(a.conditionOut).to.eql("GOOD"); pm.expect(a.assignedBy).to.eql("assetadmin"); pm.expect(a.canRequestReturn).to.be.true; pm.expect(a.overdue).to.be.false; });
pm.test("Says who has it", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("Only available assets"); pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("Postman Employee"); });

item.name: The register shows who holds it

exec: pm.test("Assigned with the holder", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(l[0].status).to.eql("ASSIGNED"); pm.expect(l[0].holderUsername).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("newUser")); });

pm.test("One item with its due date", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(l[0].assetTag).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("tagA")); pm.expect(l[0].dueDate).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("nextMonth")); });

item.name: The admin has no personal equipment list
The admin cannot accept before the request
The employee asks to return it

exec: pm.test("Return requested", () => { const a = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(a.status).to.eql("RETURN_REQUESTED"); pm.expect(a.returnNote).to.eql("Project finished"); pm.expect(a.canRequestReturn).to.be.false; });

pm.test("Queue first", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); const mine = l.find(a => a.id == pm.collectionVariables.get("assignment1")); pm.expect(mine.employeeUsername).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("newUser")); pm.expect(l[0].status).to.eql("RETURN_REQUESTED"); });

item.name: The admin checks it in as FAIR

exec: pm.test("Returned and recorded", () => { const a = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(a.status).to.eql("RETURNED"); pm.expect(a.conditionIn).to.eql("FAIR"); pm.expect(a.receivedBy).to.eql("assetadmin"); });

item.name: The asset is available again, in FAIR condition

exec: pm.test("One returned item", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(l[0].conditionIn).to.eql("FAIR"); });

item.name: Returning it again is a conflict

exec: pm.test("Condition out is the returned condition", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().conditionOut).to.eql("FAIR"));

item.name: The asset's history keeps both holders

exec: pm.test("Newest first", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(l[0].employeeUsername).to.eql("diya.patel"); pm.expect(l[1].status).to.eql("RETURNED"); });

item.name: Same status again is a conflict
An asset in repair cannot be assigned
An assigned asset cannot be moved
A retired asset cannot come back
Employees with the number of assets they hold

exec: pm.test("One employee, nothing held now", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(l[0].activeAssets).to.eql(0); });
